name: Spawner
description: Makes copies of a prefab appear while playing — on a click, when a player walks in, on a timer, or when another script asks. Copies appear at the Spawner's own spot, only on this player's client.

changelog.notes: The runtime modules it used to carry now live in one place per scene, at src/scripts/runtime/ — updating removes this folder's copy and points its scripts at the shared one, so two items can no longer disagree about the same module.
Updated for the split between a request a player sends and a broadcast the server sends.
A new "where" setting says where copies land: at the spawner (as before), at the player who set it off, or a custom spot — picking that one shows the model as a marker you place with the gizmos.
Copies are made on the player's own client the moment the trigger fires — no Multiplayer Server, nothing stored between plays, and the scene no longer needs the auth-server SDK.
Simpler settings: what sets it off comes from where it sits, spread and marker visibility are automatic, and the trigger list is down to the four that matter.
Wording pass on the settings: every one now says in plain words what the creator sees, and the timer, area, click and hover settings say which trigger they belong to. Nothing else changed.
Initial release: five triggers, a server-decided shared alive-set, per-spot cap, lifetime and scatter.
